'''rogue_wraith Liberating (v) Hoth''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[rogue_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 8 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4)|VS4O-11-Local_Uprising.png|label=Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising (V)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS4 LUV rogue wraith LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V), Nick Of Time (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Tantive IV (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Dual Laser Cannon (V), Frostbite (V), Attack Pattern Delta (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Using the virtual LU/L to make a competitive Hoth deck.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published (the section headers add to 47 plus 12 starting cards).
* ovs_pick returned a Virtual Set 7+ page (its default date makes sets 7+ legal from 2004-06-01, against its docstring); dested the newest Virtual Set 1-6 printing instead: Tantive IV (V) to Virtual Set 1 (tool gave 7), General Carlist Rieekan (V) to Virtual Set 4 (tool gave 8), Attack Pattern Delta (V) to Virtual Set 4 (tool gave 22).
* Maneuvering Flaps, Princess Leia and BoShek are unmarked, so they are the printed cards.
* Original-era (V) cards also: Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1); Nick Of Time (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), Dual Laser Cannon (V), Frostbite (V), Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4).
* Original-era printing corrected: Tantive IV (V) (Virtual Set 1) -> Tantive IV (V) (Virtual Set 7) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

Use...

LU to pull sites

EBG to pull Rogue pilots

NOT to pull guns and interupts

SKF (V) to pull matching weapons

Princess to pull Reflection

Commander LS to pull Rogue speeders

BoShek to pull devices (search Reserve deck)

General CR to pull Haven and more T-47s

Flip an use L(V) to pull anything

Basically, setup your deck however opponents strategy dictates.  I generally put a single Rogue speeder at each site for direct damage, force retrieval and force drains.  Interupts make an attempt to attack dicey (Rouge 2 + Zev + Corran + Manv Flaps + Attack PD = Battle destiny = 11), plus weapons to deal with annoying folks.  While speeders hold Hoth, everybody else goes out and has fun doing their thing to annoy and distract the opponent.
